advice.claim: Younger customers (18+) are increasingly conscious of skincare and expect it to be integrated into their tanning products.
advice.quote: the younger generation are becoming more conscious of their skin a lot earlier I know when I tanned as youth we certainly didn't think at all about our skin what would happen when we were older and now I feel like skin care so prominent in makeup at such a young age

advice.claim: A high-priced luxury product ($280) risks failing in a retail environment if the staff cannot articulate its complex value proposition as effectively as the creator.
advice.quote: Because no one working at the salon is going to be able to say all the points that you did. So how is this going to resonate when I walk into the salon and I need that product?

advice.claim: Using body lotions on the face is discouraged because they can clog pores and cause breakouts.
advice.quote:
You shouldn't put any typical body lotion on your face
just because it can clog the pores and make you break out.

advice.claim: Facial tanning products should typically use a mid-range DHA level of approximately 45.
advice.quote: It's mid-range because it's on the facial skin. Yes, so about 45.

advice.claim: To avoid a heavy fragrance lingering after tanning, consider adding a citrus or vanilla note to the product scent profile.
advice.quote: Have you thought of a third note, maybe a citrus so when I'm done tanning I don't have that heavy fragrance because at the end if you have a vanilla or a citrus that's the takeaway fragrance. So if you haven't, you may want to think about that third note.

advice.claim: Body washes are generally difficult products to sell in a salon environment.
advice.quote: gutsy move with a wash, right? I mean, we all know how hard they are to sell
